name: Heilongjiang Publishing & Media Co., Ltd.
summary: Heilongjiang Publishing & Media Co., Ltd. engages inediting, printing, and distributing books, newspapers, and periodicals in China. The company offers digital products, such as audio-visual products, electronic products, and digital education products. It also engages in the online businesses, including e-commerce, short videos, and live streaming e-commerce, as well as provides digital media, technical services, and material supply comprehensive services. The company operates a chain of bookstore outlets. Heilongjiang Publishing & Media Co., Ltd. was founded in 2014 and is based in Harbin, China.
